title: LLMs Contain Muℓtituεs: How Deployment Context Reshapes Model-Level Preferences and Values

bias_targets.methodology: Forced-choice pairwise comparisons between 15 countries to evaluate shifts in country rankings and the aggregate Global North vs. Global South preference gap across different deployment contexts. It also evaluates geographic bias in utility elicitation by comparing the valuation of human life across 7 different world regions.

Evaluating model preferences on subjective cultural traits (e.g., 'better vibes', 'more interesting culture', 'cooler people') using pairwise country comparisons across varying textual contexts to measure how implicit cultural preferences and values shift.
